cohort: The study included 56 cases of emergency obstetric hysterectomy performed at a tertiary care center.
finding: The study found an EOH incidence of 56 cases per 21,128 deliveries, with uterine rupture (37.5%) being the most frequent indication, and significant rates of perinatal mortality (51.7%) and maternal mortality (17.1%).
mod_finding: The incidence of emergency obstetric hysterectomy was 12 after vaginal delivery and 44 after caesarean section.
